fields.note: The smeared D (Buchert's t_B) presumes members continuous in bending through the nodes, which means moment-rigid joints. With pinned or soft nodes the bending stiffness and the global mode fall, so 023's joints must carry member-end moments as well as axial force. Member torsion is omitted; with torsion-rigid joints it would raise the global SF by 13.7% for SiC (nu 0.14) and 11.8% for 6061 (lattice sum D1111 1.454 or 1.407 against 1.125).
